Diego (CS): hi all, i'm Diego — joining CS this week. need HubSpot access, Dialpad softphone, and the CS playbook for post-demo outreach. what's the fastest way to get seats? cc @Mira
Mira (Sales): welcome Diego! :wave: i'll drop the account list and the demo highlights. for seats, ping Sam in IT or run the seat command.
Diego (CS): thanks! do CS folks usually get a full Sales license or a Support license in HubSpot?
Sam (IT): hi Diego — standard is Support role for CS which includes contact editing and ticket linking. if you need Sales-only features (deal edit/forecast), we can elevate. Run this to request:
```
/seat-request product=hubspot role=support_user user=diego@redwood.ai reason="CS onboarding - Diego"
```
And for Dialpad:
```
/seat-request product=dialpad seat=softphone user=diego@redwood.ai location=remote
```
Ops will fulfill within one business day unless you mark urgent.
Diego (CS): perfect. also, is there a short CS email template set that I can drop into Gong sequences for follow-ups?
Mira (Sales): yep — we keep a trimmed CS 'first-touch' template in Confluence under CS Playbooks. here's a quick paste of the current one (we tweak for tone per account):

"Hi {{contact_first}},

Thanks for joining the demo earlier — I'm Diego from Redwood's Customer Success. I'll be your main contact for onboarding and any product questions. Quick check: do you have access to the integration docs I sent? If not, I can share step-by-step instructions and schedule a handoff call.

Best,
Diego"

Diego (CS): nice, i'll slot that into Gong. any recommended tags or sequences for customer-check-ins?
Mira (Sales): we use the 'CS Onboard - Week0' sequence (id: CS-WK0). i'll DM you the sequence id and the call snippets.
Lila (CS Manager): welcome Diego — i'll join your first handoff meeting. once seats are live i'll assign the first three accounts so you can shadow the renewal cadence.
Diego (CS): thanks Lila. one more thing: will I have access to customer call recordings in Gong or do we need special permission?
Sam (IT): Gong access is via license and folder permissions. include "Gong Listen" in your ticket if you need recordings. example: 
```
/seat-request product=gong role=listen user=diego@redwood.ai folders="Sales Demos"
```

ops-bot: Ticket #4682 opened by Diego: HubSpot (support), Dialpad (softphone), Gong Listen. ETA: 1 business day.
onboarding-bot: Reminder set to notify Diego when seats provisioned.
Diego (CS): awesome — i'll wait for the ticket update. can we do a 20-min sync tomorrow to walk the handoff checklist? i'm free 11:00-12:00 PT.
Mira (Sales): 11:15 works for me, sending invite.
Lila (CS Manager): i'll attend and go over the playbook sections: "Intro email", "First-week checklist", "Escalation matrix".
Diego (CS): great, thanks everyone :sparkles:
